comment: Independent wizard-mode ^V ? menu. On page 1, F is not a current-page selector, so the menu waits; Space shows page 2, where the unplaced Fort Ludios entry was added with a zero identifier but kept menu letter F (dungeon.c tport_menu()). Pressing F there ends the PICK_ONE menu (wintty.c process_menu_window()), print_dungeon() returns 0, and level_tele() returns with a blank message line; ':' then shows that the hero has not moved.
